transit.name: Mountain Valley Transit
transit.detail: Free door-to-door rides in Salida, booked by phone with the dispatcher. The operator says all Salida local service is suspended from November 16, 2026 through the end of the year.

nameOrigin.text: Salida means exit in Spanish. The town was first named South Arkansas and was renamed for the exit, or gateway, to the Arkansas River canyon.

founded.text: Founded in 1880, when the Denver and Rio Grande Railroad reached the area

timeline.text: The Denver and Rio Grande Railroad reached the area in May and the settlement was first named South Arkansas.
Downtown burned in 1886 and again in 1888. Both times it was rebuilt in local brick.
The first FIBArk race was held on June 19 on a 56-mile course through the Royal Gorge to Cañon City.
The Salida Museum's collection was first displayed.
The Salida Downtown Historic District, 111 buildings, was listed on the National Register on June 14.
